proposal.hypothesis: Replacing sqrt-plus-division with an explicit reciprocal-square-root cube, while algebraically cancelling the positive target mass from the force/acceleration calculation, may reduce hot-loop arithmetic. The controller must determine whether the changed FP32 rounding passes the FP64 oracle and whether it improves timing.

retained: Replace sqrtf(distSq) and division by distSq * dist with rsqrtf(distSq) and its cube.
Accumulate acceleration using source mass only, algebraically cancelling the positive target mass and eliminating the final target-mass division.
Preserve the self-interaction guard and baseline thread mapping and launch configuration.
